unassigned_storage_tails.note: Outside the named MAP unit contributions; preserved as unassigned compiler/linker/project storage, not attributed to a unit without evidence.
Outside the named MAP unit contributions; no attribution inferred.

source_order_constraints.project_uses_limit: PACKAGEINFO order and initialization order do not uniquely identify source uses clauses. These sequences constrain reconstructed dependencies and cached-unit traversal; no exact original uses list is claimed.

notes: CODE lengths exclude up to three compiler alignment bytes; allocated lengths include them. The project CODE contribution ends at 0x48509D, followed by the compiler three-byte LEA alignment instruction.

RTL/VCL nontrivial initialization tails are normalized against the exact completed debugger reference. DInput tail bounds include the final DLL/API-name strings. All form VMTs and published methods lie in the assigned unit spans.

BSS/DATA contributions use the source-built unit lengths in original CODE order, with every available BSS initializer counter checked and matched-body relocation observations validating original storage positions. Field-level data references remain address identity evidence rather than proof of whole-file equality.

Whole-unit normalized comparisons can lose disassembly synchronization inside embedded data; false values are diagnostic, not proof that instructions differ. MultiMon was compared at all 12 mapped routine boundaries.

MultiMon is a reconstructed library variant: both monitor-location fallback conditions use AND, and GetMonitorInfo storage/body/initializer order is A, W, unsuffixed. Stock RTM/U1/U2/standalone-RTL-update sources all differ.
